subject: Operations
title: Free Trade Zones
description: A 60-second lesson on Free Trade Zones.

hook.text: A factory in a free trade zone imports materials duty-free and exports finished goods tariff-free. It's a tax island.

buildup.text: Free trade zones are designated areas where goods are imported, stored, and processed without standard customs duties.

discovery.text: Companies use FTZs to defer duties, reduce paperwork, and lower costs on goods destined for re-export.

twist.text: FTZs can distort location decisions—companies choose sites for tax benefits rather than operational efficiency.

climax.text: China's Shenzhen Special Economic Zone transformed from a fishing village to a tech powerhouse using FTZ incentives.

punchline.text: Free trade zones lower costs—if you plan around them.

quiz.question: What is a free trade zone?
options: An area where goods move without standard duties
